title: API Tokens
desc: Create scoped, expiring access tokens for scripts and automation
intro: Send {header} in the request header to call the management API. Each token only has the permissions selected at creation. Accounts, token management, backup and restore, restart and system settings require a login session and cannot be accessed with tokens.
emptyDesktop: No tokens yet. Click New Token at the top right.
emptyMobile: No tokens yet. Tap New Token above.
legacyTip: This is the single token from before the upgrade and has full access. Replace it with a scoped token and delete it.
legacyShort: Single token from before the upgrade with full access. Narrow its scope or delete it.
permHelp: Read/write includes read. Permissions can be changed at any time after creation and take effect immediately.
secretTitle: This token is shown only once
secretWarn: The plaintext cannot be viewed again after closing this window. Copy and store it safely now. If lost, you can only regenerate it.
expiryFuture: Expiry time must be later than now
regenerateConfirm: After regenerating "{name}", the old token value stops working immediately and scripts using it must switch to the new value. Continue?
deleteConfirm: After deleting "{name}", the token stops working immediately and cannot be recovered. Scripts using it will receive 401. Continue?
execTip: Write access to this module can run commands on the server (commands, scripts or program paths). It equals command execution as the Gately process user, so grant it only to scripts you fully trust.
execWarn: Whoever holds this token can run commands on the server through write access to: {modules}. Grant this only to scripts you fully trust.
